notes:
### Rebuilt for every desktop

- Moves Agent HUD from the native Swift app to a new cross-platform app, built with Tauri 2. A Rust core reads your agents and works out tokens, quotas, prices and sessions once, the same way on every system; a new interface shows what it computes, and a thin native layer handles each system.
- Keeps what you use every day on the Mac: the Notch, Simple and Dynamic modes, the glow, quotas and balances, token statistics and sessions, approvals and questions on the HUD, the bots, the menu bar, and Agent HUD Remote for iPhone and Apple Watch.
- Brings your settings and the last 30 days of quota history over from 0.5.5 the first time it starts, then keeps its own. Token statistics are counted again from your agents' logs.
- Makes [agent-hud-open](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open) the source of this app; it also builds on Windows and Linux, in preview. The native Swift app's source continues as [agent-hud-native-open](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-native-open).
- Stays light: about 7% of one CPU core and 240 MB of memory while your agents are idle, measured on an Apple M1 Max.

### Agents work together

- Lets a Claude Code or Codex session message another session, or start a new one, and read its reply through Agent HUD's MCP server. A message waits until the receiving session is idle and never interrupts a turn. Turn it on in Settings → Agents → Agent plugins.
- Shows every message as a paper plane that flies from the sender's mark to the receiver's, and the answer flies back the same way.
- Lets agents ask Agent HUD's MCP tools about your usage, sessions and statistics, as well as arrange the HUD.
- Adds Settings → Agents → Agent plugins, with one card per client for Agent HUD's Claude Code plugin and the MCP tools.
- Answers the questions and next-step box of the Claude desktop app on the HUD, in the session that asked, without Agent HUD Remote.

### Sessions and statistics

- Redesigns sessions. Every row draws its last 64 turns, with sub-agents faded, compactions marked and the running turn outlined. A session's page shows its state and duration, a chart per turn, a context chart with compactions and the model's limit, and a sub-agents card that splits the session's own tokens from its sub-agents'.
- Places sub-agent sessions under the session that started them, and counts their tokens in it.
- Shows the tools each Claude Code or Codex call asked for, across the whole session.
- Steps through statistics charts with ← and →, and clears the selection with Esc.

### Agents

- Adds Devin CLI: its sessions and tokens, quotas, approvals and replies.
- Shows Grok CLI and Grok Bot as two sources.
- Reads Claude Code logs under `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, and shows Claude's Haiku, Fable and Mythos weekly windows when your plan has them.
- Takes you back with one click to more sessions: Codex sessions run by its app-server, and Claude Code sessions started from the Claude desktop app.
- Picks up turns sooner: starts, ends and replies arrive as soon as an agent's hook fires, and a newly installed agent appears within seconds.
- Says on the HUD when an answer to the Codex desktop app fails, instead of leaving the card in place.
- Counts each Claude Code response's whole output, so totals from logs written before about September 2026 can read higher.

### The app

- Updates itself from now on: it checks once a day, shows New Version… in the menu bar and an arrow in the HUD panel, verifies every update before it installs, and installs only when you choose. If you joined beta releases in 0.5.5, you stay on betas.
- Brings Settings forward when you open Agent HUD a second time, and shows the real state of Open at Login, including when macOS waits for your approval in Login Items.
- Keeps Mission Control's window previews intact while Simple mode runs.

### In this beta

- The HUD has no glass material: every look is solid, with a transparency slider. The "Play a sound" option is gone.
- Not here yet from 0.5.5: the first-launch welcome, the quota forecast on hover, returning to an agent's latest session by clicking its logo in the panel, the panel's refresh-failure line, DeepSeek's low-balance colours, Grok CLI's quota, a GLM plan held only by WorkBuddy, Kimi plans without the Kimi CLI, Antigravity's quota for terminal-only agy, and the menu bar menu in the HUD's look.
- Tell us what else you notice in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/jazzenchen/agent-hud-open/issues).
